about.label: About me
about.title: I build complete web products, from the interface to the data and logic behind them.
about.introduction: I’m a <highlight>Full Stack Developer</highlight> with a strong frontend focus, specializing in React, Next.js and TypeScript. I build web applications that combine intuitive, maintainable interfaces with authentication, business logic, databases and integrations.
about.product: I enjoy working closely with product teams: understanding the problem, turning it into features and contributing throughout the development lifecycle, from defining requirements to implementation, deployment and continuous improvement.

balance.problem: Managing shared expenses as a couple or household often leads to scattered records, transfers that are hard to track and uncertainty about who paid, how much each person owes or which expenses are still outstanding.
balance.solution: I built a web application to bring shared household finances into one place. I implemented authentication, household creation and invitations, expense tracking, cost splitting, approvals and transaction history, with a secure architecture built on PostgreSQL, Row Level Security and controlled operations through RPCs.

anthropology.problem: Manual processing of administrative requests caused long delays. External inquiries about professionals were handled by email, with responses taking weeks and resulting in missed hiring opportunities.
anthropology.solution: I built a self-service platform for professionals with authentication, an admin dashboard, dynamic data management and a public professional directory. The system centralizes administrative requests and their status, allowing the Colegio to manage its information and external users to find available professionals in real time.

jujuyConecta.problem: The project needed a lightweight, independent platform to manage a daily news publishing workflow without relying on heavyweight, general-purpose CMS platforms.
jujuyConecta.solution: I built a digital newspaper with a custom CMS for publishing and managing content. I implemented an admin dashboard, technical SEO and an automated workflow for scraping, processing and publishing news using Python and GitHub Actions.

tierraArcilla.problem: A local entrepreneur needed to digitize her inventory to share it on WhatsApp, but traditional CMS platforms (WordPress/Tiendanube) were costly and difficult to maintain.
tierraArcilla.solution: I built a self-managed web application with an admin dashboard, bulk product uploads via CSV, a real-time database and dynamic metadata to improve product previews when shared on WhatsApp.

thesis.problem: The business lacked a trustworthy, authoritative digital presence to attract clients in the academic sector.
thesis.solution: I built a business website optimized for conversion, with a strategically structured information architecture designed to support lead generation.
